verdict.rationale: Glama mentions 'automate workflows using schedules or webhooks' on its pricing page, which implies some event/trigger-based automation, but there is no documented rule-definition system, no description of conditions/actions, and no independent evidence of this working in practice. missing for 10: documented rule/condition-action definition interface, examples of triggers mapping to automated actions, and independent corroboration that scheduled/webhook automation works as claimed.
